_comment: Runtime feature flags. Validated by `python3 -m altered_states.feature_flags check` (expired or unreferenced flags fail). Set expires_on to force a review date.

flags.name: site.music_section
flags.description: Render the generated-music section on the published site. Switching this off keeps the audio assets deployed but hides the player, so a broken embed never blocks a content deploy.

flags.name: site.chat_personas
flags.description: Render the in-browser persona chat panel and embed the per-substance system prompts.

flags.name: site.experiments_gallery
flags.description: Render the same-prompt experiment gallery from experiments/same-prompt/output.

flags.name: site.experiment_wheel
flags.description: The slot-machine experiment wheel. Rolled out to half of visitors while the interaction is still being tuned.

flags.name: site.substance_pages
flags.description: Generate one shareable static page per substance (site/<substance>/index.html) with its comparison table and arc.

flags.name: site.arc_timeline
flags.description: Render the dose-arc timeline visualizer (onset, ascent, peak, descent, afterglow) as a site section.

flags.name: site.diff_view
flags.description: Render the two-substance diff view comparing them across the seven phenomenological dimensions.

flags.name: site.quiz_game
flags.description: Render the Blind Taxonomy Game: guess which substance wrote an excerpt, labels stripped at build time.

flags.name: site.journal_dashboards
flags.description: Render the journal arc dashboards charting temporal-lab character phenomenology over cycles.

flags.name: site.eval_grids
flags.description: Render the side-by-side same-prompt eval grids (ten substances per screen).
